units.source_text: 夕雾回六条院去休息一下。

en.t: Yugiri returned to the Rokujo estate to rest for a while.

units.source_text: 继母花散里从容不迫地问道：“听前太政大臣家的人说，你把二公主迎接到了一条院。

en.t: His stepmother Hanachirusato asked calmly, "I hear from people in the former Chancellor's household that you have brought the Second Princess to Ichijo-in.

units.source_text: 究竟是怎么一回事？”

en.t: What exactly is going on?"

units.source_text: 两人虽然隔着帘子，又添上一个帷屏，但夕雾从一旁可以窥见花散里的姿态。

en.t: Although the two were separated by a blind, with a screen added as well, Yugiri could still glimpse Hanachirusato's figure from the side.

units.source_text: 他答道：“人们总是大惊小怪。

en.t: He replied, "People always make a great fuss over things.

units.source_text: 事实是这样：已故的老夫人起初态度强硬，认为岂有此理，拒绝我的要求。

en.t: The truth is this: at first the late old lady was firm, thought it was outrageous, and refused my request.

units.source_text: 但到了临终时候，心身都衰弱了，想是悲伤公主无人保护之故，嘱托我在她死后多多照拂。

en.t: But when she was near death, her body and spirit weakened, and perhaps because she grieved that the princess would have no protector, she asked me to look after her well after she was gone.

units.source_text: 我本有此心，便如此照办。

en.t: I had already wished to do so, and therefore acted accordingly.

units.source_text: 世人总是喜欢论短评长，平淡无奇的事，说得天花乱坠，真是多嘴啊！”

en.t: People in the world always love to judge and gossip, turning ordinary matters into extravagant tales. They really do talk too much!"

units.source_text: 说到这里笑起来。

en.t: Having said this, he laughed.

units.source_text: 接着又说：“可是公主本人深恶世俗生活，决心出家为尼，我又有什么办法呢？

en.t: Then he continued, "But the princess herself deeply detests worldly life and is determined to become a nun. What can I do about that?

units.source_text: 各处谣诼纷传，原是很讨厌的，索性让她出家，倒可避免嫌疑。

en.t: Rumors spreading everywhere are unpleasant to begin with, so if she becomes a nun outright, it may actually avoid suspicion.

units.source_text: 但我又不忍违背老夫人遗言，所以只是照拂她的生活。

en.t: Yet I cannot bear to go against the old lady's final words, so I am only looking after her daily needs.

units.source_text: 父亲如果来此，务请便中把我这番意思转告。

en.t: If Father comes here, please take the opportunity to convey these thoughts of mine to him.

units.source_text: 我深恐父亲见责，以为平安无事到了今天，忽又产生此种不良之心。

en.t: I greatly fear that Father will blame me, thinking that after all this time without incident I have suddenly developed such improper intentions.

units.source_text: 但实际上，但凡碰到恋爱之事，别人的劝谏和自己的意志似乎都是无可奈何的。”

en.t: But in truth, whenever love is involved, both other people's advice and one's own will seem powerless."

units.source_text: 后面几句话声音很低。

en.t: He spoke the last few sentences in a very low voice.

units.source_text: 花散里说：“我也疑心外间传说是虚假的，然而总有几分真吧。

en.t: Hanachirusato said, "I too suspect that the outside rumors are false, yet there must be some truth in them.

units.source_text: 这原是世间常有的事。

en.t: Such things are common in the world.

units.source_text: 只是你那三条院的夫人定然不快，却是怪可怜的。

en.t: Only, your lady at Sanjo-in must surely be unhappy, and that is rather pitiable.

units.source_text: 她太平无事地直到现在了呢。”

en.t: She has lived peacefully and without trouble until now."

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“您当她是个可爱的千金小姐么？

en.t: Yugiri said, "Do you take her for a sweet young lady?

units.source_text: 其实像鬼一般凶狠！”

en.t: In truth she is as fierce as a demon!"

units.source_text: 接着又说：“可是我决不疏远她。

en.t: Then he went on, "But I will certainly not neglect her.

units.source_text: 恕我说句放肆的话，您可从自己身上推想：为女子者，如果心平气和，结果终是便宜。

en.t: Forgive my impertinence, but you can judge from your own example: for a woman, if her heart is calm and gentle, she gains in the end.

units.source_text: 如果心怀妬恨，口出恶言，则暂时之间，丈夫为欲息事宁人，姑且让她几分，然而毕竟不能永远依她，一旦闹出事来，势必互相仇恨，变成冤家。

en.t: If she harbors jealousy and resentment and speaks harsh words, then for a time her husband may yield a little in order to keep the peace, but in the end he cannot always give way to her; once trouble breaks out, they are bound to hate each other and become enemies.

units.source_text: 总之，像南殿那位紫夫人，心地真好，对各方面都很和顺。

en.t: In short, someone like Lady Murasaki of the south wing is truly kindhearted and gentle in every respect.

units.source_text: 还有，像您老人家，更是和蔼可亲，这是众目昭彰的事。”

en.t: And as for you, my lady, you are even more warm and approachable, as everyone plainly sees."

units.source_text: 他极口称赞这位继母。

en.t: He praised this stepmother of his to the utmost.

units.source_text: 花散里笑道：“你拉出我来做范例，反而使我的缺点显著了。

en.t: Hanachirusato laughed and said, "By dragging me out as an example, you have only made my faults more obvious.

units.source_text: 所可怪者，你父亲自己犯了好色的毛病，似乎以为别人都不知道，而你稍有一点风流言行，他就当作一件大事，当面训诫，又在背后担心。

en.t: What is strange is that your father himself has the weakness of being amorous and seems to think no one knows it, yet if you show even the slightest romantic word or deed, he treats it as a grave matter, admonishes you to your face, and worries about it behind your back.

units.source_text: 真所谓‘责人则明，恕己则昏’也。”

en.t: It is just as they say: one sees clearly when blaming others, but grows blind when forgiving oneself."

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“果然如此。

en.t: Yugiri replied, "That is exactly so.

units.source_text: 父亲常为此事训诫我。

en.t: Father often admonishes me about this matter.

units.source_text: 其实即使他不教导我，我也会谨慎小心的。”

en.t: In fact, even if he did not instruct me, I would still be cautious and careful."

units.source_text: 他觉得父亲实在可笑。

en.t: He found his father truly absurd.
